items.q: How many formats can I convert between?
items.a: You can convert between 150+ image formats, including modern ones like WebP, AVIF, and HEIC, as well as professional formats like PSD, TIFF, and RAW files.

items.q: Will I lose image quality during conversion?
items.a: We use high-quality encoding engines. You can manually adjust the quality/compression settings to ensure your output looks exactly how you want it, whether you're optimizing for web or print.

items.q: Can I convert HEIC photos from my iPhone to JPG?
items.a: Yes! Our converter is perfect for transforming HEIC files into widely compatible JPG or PNG formats directly in your browser without uploading them to a server.

items.q: Is there a limit to the number of files I can convert?
items.a: No. You can convert as many files as you want, one by one or in batches (depending on the tool module), completely for free.
